notes.title: 🎣 Fishing Paradiso Comes to Wish Upon a Cat!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463337/7648df4746b5fb88e41064bae89246fc9461caee.png"][/img][/p][p]The protagonist and beloved companions from [i]Fishing Paradiso[/i]
now appear in Odencat’s new free game [i]Wish Upon a Cat[/i]![/p][p]If you’ve ever found comfort in the afterlife’s ocean breeze,
this light multiverse adventure will reel you right back in.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857590/Wish_Upon_a_Cat/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Fix for Freezing Issue
notes.notes: We have fixed an issue where the game could freeze during play when using the latest version of the Steam SDK. Additionally, minor bug fixes and performance improvements have been made.

notes.title: Tropical Bundle with Kairosoft is here!
notes.notes:
A miraculous collaboration bundle brought to you by Kairosoft, the creator of numerous simulation games, and ODENCAT!  It's called the "Kairosoft x ODENCAT Tropical Bundle"!

Enjoy Kairosoft's "Tropical Resort Story" and ODENCAT's "Fishing Paradiso" to your heart's content. Enjoy fishing and vacation in a tropical paradise!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44392/Kairosoft_x_Odencat_Tropical_Bundle/?hl=japanese

notes.title: Added German translation!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We've added German translation.
[*] Improved English grammar and expressions.
[*] Made fish shadows in the fishing spot move more smoothly.
[/list]

notes.title: Golan from Meg's Monster is now playable!
notes.notes:
You can now choose Golan skin from the Ninjutsu "Transformation"! It is a bonus feature that can be accessed after beating the game. It's just a small addition, but please enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463337/00e4b3a94cba7b23f70324ef49dbb0692ba47b52.png[/img]

Also, we have fixed issues where the game could not start on some Windows systems.

notes.title: Reduced the memory usage
notes.notes: Good news! We've improved the build so that it consumes less memory when it is running. We hope it'd reduce the crashes for the players.

notes.title: Birdy improvement
notes.notes:
- Improved birdy's voice sound
- Improved birdy's message font

notes.title: Make it easier to level up for the late game.
notes.notes: I hope these changes help players to have a better time.

notes.title: Fixed Steamdeck/Linux crash at launch
notes.notes: Now the game is playable on [i]Steamdeck[/i]!

notes.title: Fixed a crash happening when activating the window.
notes.notes: There were reports that the game crashes when clicking the window of the game. This update fixes that problem.

notes.title: Fixed a launch crash problem
notes.notes: Depending on your PC, the game had an issue launching. We applied a fix.

notes.title: French is now available for the game!
notes.notes: Fishing Paradiso is finally available in French! Merci!

notes.title: Minor message bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where some messages exceed the screen.

notes.title: Casual relaxing indie RPG 'Fishing Paradiso' is out now
notes.notes:
From the developer of the indie hit Bear’s Restaurant, Odencat has released Fishing Paradiso, a cozy fishing RPG.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/06/casual-relaxing-indie-rpg-fishing-paradiso-is-out-now

notes.title: Alt+Enter fix
notes.notes:
- Fixed a crash that happens when Alt+Enter is pressed. 
- Fixed a potential fix related to input functionality

notes.title: Fixed various crashes
notes.notes:
- Fixed crashes on Linux
- Fixed a crash that happened after pressing Alt+Enter
- Fixed a problem where the save data can be corrupted in a very rare case

notes.title: Linux crash fix
notes.notes: Potential fix for crashes on Linux. If the issue still remains please let us know in the "Bug Report Thread" in the forum.

notes.title: Foodie Friends Fix
notes.notes: Fixed "Foodie Friends" displaying incorrect ingredient information for the Spanish

notes.notes:

Fishing Paradiso Demo is a one-hour-long game. 
The developer will play through the game and stream the gameplay in live.

notes.title: Relaxing tropical adventure Fishing Paradiso announced for 2022
notes.notes:
Fishing Paradiso is the next title from Japanese developer Odencat, who also created Bear's Restaurant, with a release planned to arrive with Linux support in early 2022.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/11/relaxing-tropical-adventure-fishing-paradiso-announced-for-2022
